name: proshop_mern
description: Full-stack eCommerce platform (MERN) with MCP servers, RAG search, feature flags dashboard, and n8n automation

tech_stack.frontend: React 16 + Redux 4 + Thunk + React-Bootstrap + React Router 5

backend.description: Express REST API — products, users, orders, feature flags, file upload, n8n proxy

frontend.description: React SPA — product catalog, cart, checkout, admin CRUD, feature flags dashboard

mcp-feature-flags.description: Python MCP server — manages feature flags in backend/features.json via FastMCP tools + REST API

mcp-rag-search.description: Python MCP server — semantic search over project docs using BGE-M3 embeddings + Qdrant

scripts.description: Data pipeline — chunk markdown docs, vectorize with BGE-M3, index into Qdrant, query/search

n8n-workflows.description: n8n workflow definitions — WF1 manual feature flag toggle, WF2 scheduled error rate monitor

simulators.description: Test simulators — WF1 dispatcher, traffic generator, threshold validator

system_folders..claude/: Claude Code config — agents/, settings, memory
system_folders.project-data/: Living documentation — ADRs, API specs, features, runbooks, incidents
system_folders.docs/: Additional docs — chunking spec, M6 course materials
system_folders.homework-m6/: M6 homework submission — stage1 through stage4

root_files.CLAUDE.md: Main agent rules file — conventions, architecture, gotchas
root_files.DESIGN.md: Design system — CSS variables, spacing scale, font rules
root_files.docker-compose.yml: MongoDB + n8n containers + MCP server configs
root_files..mcp.json: MCP server configuration for Claude Code
root_files.package.json: Root monorepo scripts (dev, server, client, data:import/destroy)

hard_rules: ALWAYS read project-index.json FIRST at session start.
Read CLAUDE.md before modifying any code — it contains critical gotchas (Node v16, .js extensions in imports, port 5001).
Do not edit frontend/src/bootstrap.min.css — use index.css for overrides.
Feature flags: use MCP tools (set_feature_state, adjust_traffic_rollout) — never edit backend/features.json directly.
ES Modules in backend — .js extension required in all imports.
Route order matters in Express — specific paths before param routes.
Explanations in Russian, code and comments in English.

ai_routing.product_questions: search_project_docs first, then grep+read as fallback
